description: This file implements a class and functions to traverse and modify an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for shader code, specifically replacing problematic pow() calls with equivalent expressions to work around driver issues.

classes.name: RemovePowTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that converts all pow operations in the AST where the exponent is a constant, replacing them with equivalent exp2/log2 expressions.

methods.name: IsProblematicPow
methods.description: Checks if a node represents a pow() call with a constant exponent, which is problematic.

methods.name: RemovePowTraverser::RemovePowTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a symbol table.

methods.name: RemovePowTraverser::visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes to identify and replace problematic pow() calls.

methods.name: RemovePow
methods.description: Main function that applies the traverser to the AST, iterating until all problematic pow() calls are replaced.
